cohort: 542 premature infants born at <32 weeks gestational age admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of the Children's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University from January 2018 to December 2020
finding: A nomogram incorporating birth weight, cesarean delivery, and ventilation status at day 7 and 14 effectively predicted the probability of BPD in premature infants born at <32 weeks gestational age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a significant factor associated with BPD in the study.
